verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents its own yield-bearing account: Jeeves Cash multi-currency accounts earning up to 5%. That covers the high-yield holding element of the story. Nothing in the pack shows a dedicated savings sub-account or automated transfer or sweep rules for building a cushion. The scheduled-payment feature is a one-off vendor payment for a future date, not a recurring internal transfer rule. Missing for 10: a dedicated savings or reserve sub-account, automated or recurring transfer rules into it, documentation of yield terms, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can build a cash cushion in a high-yield savings sub-account with automated transfer rules

citations.quote: Jeeves Cash: Multi-currency accounts with up to 5% yield, real-time FX conversion, and multi-currency balance storage.
Manage cash in multiple currencies, issue cards, pay bills, and earn up to 5% annually
